parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human Huntingtin target CHEMBL5514. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id is CHEMBL5514 and assays.assay_organism is Homo sapiens. Require structures by inner joining compound_structures on molregno. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID.
